note: Botswana's large banks: First National Bank Botswana (the largest), Absa Bank Botswana and Stanbic Bank Botswana. FNB Botswana's retail tariff guide (effective 1 February 2025, still the latest on its site: a 2026 guide answered 404) and its lending rates for October 2026 were read: its four credit cards, the Firstcard, Gold, Platinum and Private Clients cards (sold by the holder's income band, which the game doesn't check), cost P157.50, P221.60, P253.10 and P273.40 a year, a joining fee of P109.35 and P8.05 for a cash withdrawal at FNB's own ATMs (P11.50 at another local ATM, P52.80 abroad; the own-ATM fee is written); credit cards bear a nominal 22% to 28% a year, written at the top with its lowest as from. The guide states no late, over-limit or foreign transaction fee for the cards. Absa Botswana's site lists no tariff guide (its rates and fees page answered 404), and Stanbic Botswana's wasn't found; neither is written.
